map.输入一组数据，计算偏度Skewness与峰度Kurtosis，判断分布是否左偏或: Enter a dataset to compute skewness and kurtosis, judging whether the distribution is left or right skewed and whether it is more peaked or flatter than normal — helping identify distribution shape and unusual tail behavior.
map.偏度 g₁ = m₃ / m₂^1.5；峰度（超额）= m₄ / m₂² − 3: Skewness g₁ = m₃ / m₂^1.5; kurtosis (excess) = m₄ / m₂² − 3, where mₖ = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)ᵏ / n
map.用总体中心矩度量分布形态：偏度 g₁ = m₃/m₂^1.5，正值右偏（长尾在右: Population central moments describe the distribution shape: skewness g₁ = m₃/m₂^1.5, positive for right skew (long tail on the right) and negative for left skew; excess kurtosis = m₄/m₂² − 3, positive meaning more peaked and heavy-tailed than normal and negative meaning flatter. Here mₖ is the k-th central moment (divided by n). This page computes population moments for a fixed set of 10 values.
map.同时给出偏度（不对称）与超额峰度（尾重）。: Returns both skewness (asymmetry) and excess kurtosis (tail weight).
map.：偏度≈0.8（右偏）、超额峰度≈0.5（略尖峰）：分布右拖尾、较正态稍尖。: : skewness ≈ 0.8 (right skew) and excess kurtosis ≈ 0.5 (slightly peaked) mean a right-tailed, slightly more peaked distribution than normal.
map.：超额峰度>0 表示尾部比正态厚，极值风险更高（金融中常见）。: Excess kurtosis above 0 means the tails are heavier than normal, so extreme-value risk is higher (common in finance).

map.超额峰度为何减 3？: Why Is 3 Subtracted for Excess Kurtosis?
map.正态峰度为 3，超额峰度=峰度−3，使正态为 0，便于判\"厚尾(>0)/薄尾(: Normal kurtosis is 3, so excess kurtosis = kurtosis − 3 makes the normal case 0, making it easy to judge "heavy tails (>0) / light tails (<0)".
map.偏峰度能定分布？: Can Excess Kurtosis Identify a Distribution?
map.不能唯一确定，仅描述矩特征；需结合 QQ 图/拟合检验。: It cannot determine it uniquely — it only describes moment features; combine it with a QQ plot or a fit test.
